house_name: home, and what you came from
job: The house she lives in and the one she was made in. What she inherited and is still running on without having chosen it.
agency: Your choice has been guided to
obligation: THE DOOR, AND BOTH WINDFALLS. ⭐ FIRST: the letter said "It shows me the windfalls arrive. It does not show me which door they come through." The house it fell in IS the door — name it in ordinary words, say what arrives and how she would recognise it. ⭐ SECOND, AND IT IS ALWAYS THE ONE THAT GETS MISSED: the letter promised TWO. "There is a windfall sitting in this card… and it isn't the only one. There's a second behind it, and the second is the one that changes your love life." So name both. Say what the first is and what it comes through, then say what the second is and why it changes her love life rather than her bank balance. ⛔ A reading that names one windfall has half-paid this card, and she is holding the letter that promised two. ⛔ AND NEITHER WINDFALL CARRIES A DATE. The letter promised her the DOOR, not the day — see `timing` below. The World is not the dated room.
keynote: a card of luck arriving where you were made

obligation: WHICH OF THE TWO TREES — AND THE PROMISE THAT BRANCH CARRIES. The letter gave her two readings and refused to choose: "the serpent tree is appetite… the tree of flames is the thing that's lastingly alive for you. Both feel exactly like love in the first weeks. One of them costs you a year." The house it fell in separates them. Say WHICH, flat, and say how this room decided it. ⭐ THEN PAY THE BRANCH YOU CHOSE, AND ONLY THAT ONE — they contradict each other, so never both. RENEWAL (something she already holds) → pay the letter's flat promise: "the person on your mind is going to become more attentive toward you than they have ever been." Say by when, and what the first sign of it looks like. ARRIVAL (not yet in her hands) → this is the offer's own name, and the letter promised the twelve would deliver it: say the words TWIN FLAME, name the week he comes, and say what he looks like when he does — ordinary clothes on an ordinary day, never lightning. And make the letter's distinction: a twin flame ARRIVING and a twin flame RECOGNISED are two different events, and women miss theirs because they are braced for the wrong thing. ⛔ She is holding the letter that promised all of this. It is the one thing she will check. ⭐ AND THIS IS THE ONE ROOM IN THE READING THAT IS DATED — the only one. The letter said "the full spread gives me the day… which door he comes through, which week". Every other room runs on the reading's two-month window and carries no week count, so the date here has to be worth being the only one in the document. See `timing` below.
keynote: a card of a meeting made in the open
